title: Where a project has got to
description: Three curves at one moment: what was planned to have been spent by now, what has been spent, and what has actually been earned. The two gaps are the point of the drawing — how far under the earned value is against what was spent, and how far behind it is against the plan — and neither of them is a point on the diagram.
caption: One gap is measured down and the other along, which is why a span runs between two points rather than along an axis.
